# new helper next to phrase_timing_paths():
def timing_calibration_output_root(value):
    root = s2_output_relative(value)
    if os.path.lexists(root) and not root.is_dir():
        raise ToolError('timing calibration output_root must be a directory')
    if not root.exists() and not root.parent.is_dir():
        raise ToolError('timing calibration output_root parent must be an existing directory')
    return root

# command builder, next to the phrase_timing branch:
    if name == 'timing_calibration_analyze':
        segments = s2_input_file(args['segments'], PHRASE_TIMING_MAX_INPUT_BYTES)
        if segments.suffix != '.json':
            raise ToolError('timing calibration segments must be an existing .json file')
        source = s2_original_path(args['input'])
        source = s2_input_directory(source, ('denoised.wav', 'manifest.json')) if source.is_dir() else s2_input_file(source, 4_000_000_000)
        command = head + [str(ROOT / 'scripts/timing_calibration.py'), 'analyze', str(source), '--segments', str(segments),
                          '--distances', args['distances'], '--distance-method', args['distance_method'],
                          '--amp-chain', args['amp_chain'], '--setup-id', args['setup_id'],
                          '--output-root', str(timing_calibration_output_root(args['output_root']))]
        if 'room_temp_c' in args:
            command += ['--room-temp-c', str(args['room_temp_c'])]
        return command
    if name == 'timing_calibration_apply':
        inputs = []
        for field in ('phrase_timing', 'calibration'):
            path = s2_input_file(args[field], PHRASE_TIMING_MAX_INPUT_BYTES)
            if path.suffix != '.json':
                raise ToolError('timing calibration ' + field + ' must be an existing .json file')
            inputs.append(path)
        return head + [str(ROOT / 'scripts/timing_calibration.py'), 'apply', '--phrase-timing', str(inputs[0]),
                       '--calibration', str(inputs[1]), '--setup-id', args['setup_id'],
                       '--output-root', str(timing_calibration_output_root(args['output_root']))]
